text:
incident-bot: PAGING: GPU capacity exhaustion in europe-west1 — autoscaler hitting quota limits, queue growing >5k. Severity: P1. Channel: #incidents. Runbook: <https://runbooks.redwood/prod/gpu-quota>

riley: noticing spike in inference queue, failed scale-ups. seeing repeated attach deny from GCP.

maria: confirmed: gcloud shows GPU quota at 100% for project redwood-prod in europe-west1. quota type: nvidia-t4 (accelerator type).

jordan: logs: `AttachVolumeFailed: attachDenied: Quota exceeded` and kube events: `FailedScheduling: 0/150 nodes available: Insufficient accelerators`.

alex: quick check — can we drain some non-critical pools? warm-pool has 40 idle instances we can repurpose?

riley: warm-pool is regional in us-central, not europe. but we have ephemeral quota in europe-west2 (small) — can we route some traffic?

tara: customer-impact: some hosted API customers see request latency spikes and 429s. Support is getting tickets.

oliver-pm: need one-liner for customers — are we throttling, failing, or falling back?

support-ops: raising prod incidents to affected customers, note: degraded latency and queuing — no data loss.

maria: mitigation attempt 1: scaled down internal batch workers in europe-west1 by 50% to free up GPUs. running command:```kubectl scale deployment batch-workers --replicas=6 -n prod-eu-west1```

jordan: mitigation attempt 2: temporary policy change to preferential routing to europe-west2 for read-heavy routes. updating traffic router now.

incident-bot: On-call handoff: riley -> maria in 10m. Escalate to eng-platform if attach denies continue.

riley: ran `gcloud compute project-info describe --project=redwood-prod` and `gcloud compute regions describe europe-west1` — per-region GPU quota shows limit=160, usage=160.

maria: opened support case with GCP (case 12567890). ETA: uncertain, filing request to increase quota ASAP.

alex: short-term: enable model-variant fallback to smaller GPU/CPU-only for non-SLAbound customers. editing routing rules:```
# route config snippet
- route: /generate
  priority: 20
  fallback_model: gpt-small-cpu
  condition: non_sla
```

tara: can product approve customer messaging? oliver-pm?

oliver-pm: yes — draft: "We are experiencing GPU capacity constraints in europe-west1 causing increased latency and rate limits for some customers. We are routing traffic to fallback regions and model variants; no data loss. We'll update once quotas are increased." Send asap.

support-ops: posted to status page and created incident ticket INC-2026-453.

jordan: sharing diagnostics snippet:```kubectl get events -n prod | grep -i attach
2026-03-17T10:12:05 FailedScheduling Insufficient accelerators
2026-03-17T10:12:12 AttachVolumeFailed attachDenied: PROJECT_QUOTA_EXCEEDED
```

maria: running quick audit to ensure no runaway jobs: `psql -h jobs-db -c "select id, gpu_count, state from jobs where state='running' order by gpu_count desc limit 10;"`

incident-bot: Page routed to eng-platform @channel attempting quota escalation steps.

alex: mitigation attempt 3: spun up emergency routing rule to limit non-critical customers to 20% of europe-west1 capacity:```curl -X POST https://router.redwood/api/limits -d '{"region":"europe-west1","non_sla_pct":20}'```

riley: good move. also enabling aggressive KV/prefix caching to reduce token QPS for chat routes.

tara: initial customer impact summary: ~7% of production API keys seeing 500/429, latency 2-5x 95th. major customers mostly unaffected so far.

maria: support case updated with attach logs and quota usage. GCP asked for justification and traffic patterns. they marked it high.

jordan: oncall note: autoscaler attempts show repeated CreateNodeGroup calls returning 403/QuotaExceeded from API. stack: autoscaler -> infra-provisioner -> cloud API.

oliver-pm: what's the rollback / long-term mitigation plan?

alex: long-term: pre-apply regional quota requests, replicate warm pools to eu regions, and add cross-region warm fallback. For now: traffic routing + model fallbacks + scaling down non-critical workloads.

support-ops: ongoing: ticket updates to customers every 30m. next update in 20m.

incident-bot: Time since page: 28m. Current status: mitigation in progress, GCP case raised. Next: escalate to SOC if quotas not expanded in 1h.

riley: handing off fully to maria for the next shift. maria, I left list of high-GPU jobs to terminate if needed (IDs in internal note).

maria: ack takeover. will continue mitigation, keep status updates and coordinate with eng-platform for quota workarounds.

jordan: leaving diagnostics and links: logs: https://logs.redwood/prod/query?q=gpu%20quota%20attach ; runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/prod/gpu-quota ; dashboard: https://dash.redwood/allocs/europe-west1

support-ops: thanks team — posting next customer update now. :thumbsup:

riley: :thumbsup: backfill docs if you make any persistent policy changes.

maria: will do. closing handoff.
